player_0.content: New plan: I incorrectly identified the error as a change in Named Entities (Option D) when the actual error was a change in a modifier/adjective ("unvollständige" [incomplete] was translated as "complete"). My strategy failed because I did not rigorously compare the specific adjectives and determiners in the source text against the translation before selecting an option. Next time, I will systematically scan the source sentence for every adjective and modifier, verify if it is preserved or altered in the translation, and select the corresponding category (Modifiers or Adjectives) if a mismatch is found, rather than jumping to entity or fact-based errors.
